g.text: Find earliest event time t_event ∈ [t_left, t_right]
- If single event in [left, mid] with |g| ≤ tol → converged
- If multiple events in [left, mid] → narrow to left half
- If no events in [left, mid] → narrow to right half
Multiple events detected in [left, mid] → earliest event must be in this interval
[No events in [left, mid] → events in [mid, right]]
No events in [left, mid] → event must be in [mid, right]
Create new working snapshot at mid
Multiple events may occur at same t_event
Both treated as simultaneous at t_event (to be handled in Phase 5 superdense time)
Phase 4 will step ALL components from t_left to t_event.
Event sources must be at t_left, not at t_event.
